description: DB-M16 cost-calculator behaviour. No pricing rates live here (all prices come from config/pricing/pricing-catalogue.json via Get-AiPriceAt). No secrets.
note: INCLUDED_IN_OUTPUT (default): reasoning tokens are covered by the OutputPricePerMillion dimension and are never double-charged. SEPARATE: reasoning tokens are priced separately via the pricing record's ReasoningTokenPricePerMillion. The choice is config data, never inferred from a provider name.
